meta.name: parallel-feature-development
meta.description: Coordinate parallel feature development with file ownership strategies, conflict avoidance rules, and integration patterns for multi-agent implementation. Use this skill when decomposing a large feature into independent work streams, when two or more agents need to implement different layers of the same system simultaneously, when establishing file ownership to prevent merge conflicts in a shared codebase, when designing interface contracts so parallel implementers can build against each other's APIs before they are ready, or when deciding whether to use vertical slices versus horizontal layers for a full-stack feature.

copy.tagline: 把大型功能拆成小块，多团队同时开发互不干扰
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果团队需要多人同时开发一个功能的不同部分
copy.tagline_en: Coordinate parallel development of large features without conflicts
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your team develops different parts of a feature concurrently

howto.what: Claude 会把一个大功能拆成若干可并行的开发流,为每个实现者划定文件归属、设计接口契约,并选择纵向切分或横向分层的集成方式,同时处理分支与合并流程。
howto.when: 当你需要把大功能拆成独立工作流、让两个以上智能体同时实现同一系统的不同层,或要为共享代码库划定文件归属以避免冲突时,它会接管。

say.text: 把这个登录功能拆成几条并行开发流,给每个实现者划定文件归属
say.note: 它会给出按目录、模块或分层的归属方案

say.text: 这个全栈功能用纵向切分还是横向分层?给个建议
say.note: 它会比较两种集成方式的取舍

say.text: 两个实现者都要改同一个文件,怎么避免合并冲突?
say.note: 它会给出单归属或抽取接口的做法

howto.what_en: Claude decomposes a large feature into parallel work streams, assigns file ownership per implementer, designs interface contracts, picks vertical-slice or horizontal-layer integration, and manages branches and merges.
howto.when_en: Use when splitting a large feature into independent work streams, when agents implement different layers at once, or when you need file ownership rules to avoid merge conflicts in a shared codebase.

say_en.text: Split this login feature into parallel streams and assign file owners
say_en.note: It proposes directory, module, or layer ownership

say_en.text: Should this full-stack feature use vertical slices or horizontal layers?
say_en.note: It compares the tradeoffs of both patterns

say_en.text: Two implementers need the same file — how do we avoid merge conflicts?
say_en.note: It gives single-owner or extracted-interface options
